decisions.reason: The height-adjustable desk system builds directly on the firm's core table and office furniture expertise, so its absorptive capacity supports learning from market feedback and improving the product, making a drop unlikely.
Chairs are central to the firm's furniture manufacturing knowledge, giving it strong absorptive capacity to interpret results and continue improving the product.

Floor cushions made from carpets rely on textile and carpet knowledge outside the firm's core furniture competencies, limiting its ability to assimilate feedback and improve, so withdrawal is more likely.
The upholstered sofa is close to the firm's existing seating and upholstery capabilities, and the EOOS collaboration provides additional external design knowledge, supporting retention.
The high standing table is highly related to the firm's desk and table production knowledge, enabling effective learning and improvement, so a drop is unlikely.
A rug collection requires weaving and textile expertise far from the firm's existing furniture manufacturing knowledge, weakening absorptive capacity and making withdrawal more probable.
